title: NEAT: Concept driven Neuron Attribution in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying male- and female-specific 'concept neurons' using concept vectors, then progressively deactivating them and measuring the impact on gender prediction accuracy and the gender gap using the Bias in Bios dataset.

Measuring the shift in the model's log-probability preference between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentence pairs specific to the Indian socio-cultural context using the IndiBias dataset, before and after deactivating targeted stereotype neurons.
